2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000030_REFUGEEMAN
2.description: No, no... We were promised an escape... Not the same doom we fled...

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000050_FOURCHENAULT
4.description: I shall not meet my final days here in this blasted waste.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000060_FOURCHENAULT
5.description: Calm yourselves! Your panic is our greatest enemy.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000070_FOURCHENAULT
6.description: Come, we must build a line of defense.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000090_ALPHINAUD
8.description: Leave the fighting to us, Father. You must lead the people to safety!

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000120_ESTINIEN
11.description: I can handle this pair. You...

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000130_ALPHINAUD
12.description: Shall tend to the refugees. Let us be about it!

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000140_ESTINIEN
14.description: As you wish, my little lord!

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000190_PALAKASWOMANB
19.description: No, no, n-no, don't! I don't want to die...

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000200_JULLUS
20.description: (-???-)Forward! Let not a single fiend escape!

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000220_ALPHINAUD
22.description: Jullus and the army! So, you've recovered, then!

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000230_JULLUS
23.description: In time enough to be of aid, for once.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000240_JULLUS
24.description: We can speak of it more later. For now, we must fight!

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000250_JULLUS
25.description: To repay your salvation in kind─or with better.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000280_FOURCHENAULT
28.description: Good gods... Of all possible saviors, the imperial army?

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000300_ALISAIE
30.description: I had hoped to take all of them down at once!

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000310_GRAHATIA
31.description: Think a withdrawal might be in order?

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000320_ALISAIE
32.description: Sod that! You-know-who would never abandon these people to their fate.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000330_ALISAIE
33.description: To be devoured by their former friends─that'd be beyond cruel. These beasts must fall here and now!

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000340_GRAHATIA
34.description: Well then, I'd say it's high time we threw caution to the winds!

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000350_ALISAIE
35.description: So long as you spare me the heroic sacrifices.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000370_GRAHATIA
37.description: Not the barest trace of aether... Maybe there really is no way to bring them back.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000380_PALAKASMAN
38.description: Thank you for saving our lives once again!

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000390_PALAKASMAN
39.description: I remember you, from Purusa. You helped us there, too, didn't you?

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000400_ALISAIE
40.description: Ah, you're from Palaka's Stand! I'm glad you're still in one piece.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000410_ALISAIE
41.description: ...Or you will be, once I see to that injury of yours.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000470_GRAHATIA
47.description: I won't lose them...not a one. This will be a brighter future.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000480_GRAHATIA
48.description: I won't let a madman's apocalypse ruin everything we fought to achieve!

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000490_ALISAIE
49.description: Get it together, Alisaie! You're embarrassing yourself...and in front of Father, no less.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000500_ALISAIE
50.description: You might never measure up to our champion...

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000510_ALISAIE
51.description: But we ask too much of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> as it is. You mustn't let our sword in the darkness fight alone!

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000520_ALISAIE
52.description: But we ask too much of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> as it is. You mustn't let Eorzea's hero fight alone!

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
56.description: You've done well in my absence.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
57.description: This is precisely why you should never skip your squat regimen.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000550_ALISAIE
59.description: I can look after myself, you know.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000570_ALISAIE
61.description: I've had enough of this rabble. Come on!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000580_FOURCHENAULT
62.description: You must board without delay. The ship will depart ere long.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000590_PALAKASWOMANA
63.description: Your offer to host us in Sharlayan is most appreciated, but will the Final Days not soon fall upon it as well?

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000600_FOURCHENAULT
64.description: Your hesitation is not unwarranted. The satrap entrusted me with your lives, yet I have failed your comrades.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000610_FOURCHENAULT
65.description: Nor are you wrong to fear that this corruption will continue to spread. I cannot promise you complete safety, even in my homeland.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000620_FOURCHENAULT
66.description: What I can promise is that I will do all in my power to protect you.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000630_FOURCHENAULT
67.description: That power is not inconsiderable. Even now, my countrymen are preparing the vessel that will deliver us to a sanctuary on the moon.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000640_FOURCHENAULT
68.description: Join us on our journey there and beyond, to new horizons. Come to Old Sharlayan. Please.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000650_PALAKASWOMANA
69.description: We would be fools to refuse such a generous offer made in earnest.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000660_ALPHINAUD
70.description: It seems they've a new destination.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000670_FOURCHENAULT
71.description: The people of Radz-at-Han have known too much suffering. The march to Garlemald will only bring them more, short though it may be.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000680_ALPHINAUD
72.description: I quite agree. Fortunately, they have you to look after them.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000730_GRAHATIA
77.description: You'll be all right. Hurry to the airship.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000750_ZENOS
79.description: A heretofore unseen beast. 'Twas ripe for the slaying.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000760_ZENOS
80.description: Poor sport, alas. Unfit to temper my blade.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000770_ALISAIE
81.description: Oh, for the love of─ You cannot <hex:021A020203>still<hex:021A020103> be on about a rematch!

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000780_ZENOS
82.description: That is and has ever been my sole concern.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000790_ZENOS
83.description: You, on the other hand, are fixated on a different quarry.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000800_ZENOS
84.description: Your passion pales before mine, yet neither hate nor despair seem sufficient to recapture your misdirected bloodlust.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000810_ZENOS
85.description: So I hone my blade, and I wait.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000820_JULLUS
86.description: That's it? That's all you care about?

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000830_JULLUS
87.description: Garlemald is in ruins. Our homeland─the nation you rule!─is as good as gone.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000840_JULLUS
88.description: Along with so many of its people.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000850_JULLUS
89.description: Not just soldiers like us! Not only those who fought and killed for power and duty. Innocent civilians...

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000860_JULLUS
90.description: Murdered by their own flesh and blood. Lost and confused as they breathed their last.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000870_JULLUS
91.description: While we who survived with our lives and minds intact were left to freeze to death!

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000880_JULLUS
92.description: The Eorzeans tell me all this was your doing. You slaughtered your countrymen. You did. For what?

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000890_ZENOS
93.description: For nothing, in the end. So much wasted effort.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000920_ALPHINAUD
96.description: For your own sake, Jullus, you must control your anger!

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000930_ALPHINAUD
97.description: It will serve no one should it consume you and see you transformed.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000950_ZENOS
99.description: Would you be “happier” had I a “good reason”?

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000970_ZENOS
101.description: If my motives met with your approval, would you no longer resent the outcome?

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000980_ZENOS
102.description: If so, then perhaps a beast's skin would suit you better.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_000990_ZENOS
103.description: Duty...honor...morality...all constructs of convenience, when put to proof.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001000_ZENOS
104.description: Surely the war taught you how easily power becomes the tool of the self-righteous?

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001010_ZENOS
105.description: How the people's “justice” was merely a means to their ends?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001020_ZENOS
106.description: Yet you would ask me why.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001030_ZENOS
107.description: Ask any creature of this star and those above for answers, and they will tell you what suits their fancy.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001040_ZENOS
108.description: And they would be right to do so. What meaning there is to be found in the petty vicissitudes of your existence must be gleaned by you and you alone.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001050_ZENOS
109.description: Should you seek it in battle─in the fruitless pursuit of my demise─then come. Assume your rightful place as a notch on my blade.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001060_JULLUS
110.description: You are a blight on the Garlean race, and there would be no more satisfying way to expunge it than by beating you to death.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001070_JULLUS
111.description: But I will not be party to another tragedy. I refuse to lose anyone else because of you.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001080_JULLUS
112.description: So go! Go, and may we never suffer your madness again.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001100_ALISAIE
114.description: Perhaps you've found meaning in living this way─I cannot deny you've found strength.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001110_ALISAIE
115.description: Yet if you only pursue your hedonistic pleasures, and pay no heed to the plight of others, then no one will give you the time of day.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001120_ALISAIE
116.description: You will never get what you want─not even the battle you pine for so dearly.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001130_ALISAIE
117.description: You'll be alone for an eternity, and you'll deserve every agonizing second of it.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001140_FOURCHENAULT
118.description: We are ready to depart. The refugee ships will be leaving shortly, but I've asked mine to remain for the time being.

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001150_FOURCHENAULT
119.description: There's room enough for you to join me on it, if you wish.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001160_FOURCHENAULT
120.description: Do contain your surprise. I needn't agree with the Scions' methods or intentions to acknowledge that their deeds are deserving of gratitude.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001170_ALPHINAUD
121.description: We appreciate the offer, but might I ask why you are delaying your departure? I presume it is not solely for our benefit.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001180_FOURCHENAULT
122.description: I must visit Garlemald ere we return to Sharlayan. Having caused such an uproar, 'tis only meet that I explain myself to the Ilsabard contingent.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001190_ALPHINAUD
123.description: Allow us to accompany you, then. We should be glad to facilitate, given our familiarity with all concerned.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001200_ALPHINAUD
124.description: If you would like to join as well, Jullus, we can speak of recent events on the way.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001210_ESTINIEN
125.description: He'll be after your seat on the Forum next.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001230_LUCIA
127.description: I briefed the recovered soldiers and sent them on their way as quickly as I could, but nevertheless feared they would not make it in time.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001240_ALPHINAUD
128.description: The additional support was invaluable. Your men saved more than a few lives.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001250_ALPHINAUD
129.description: ...Though not all, I regret to say.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001260_FOURCHENAULT
130.description: I take it that I am addressing Lucia Junius? I am the Forum's envoy, Fourchenault Leveilleur.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001270_FOURCHENAULT
131.description: And you are owed an explanation for these most dire developments.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001280_LUCIA
132.description: Another trial wrought by the Final Days... I was beginning to suspect as much.

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001290_LUCIA
133.description: You doubtless feel some consternation having been forced to abandon your original plan─but trust me when I say you were right to send the refugees elsewhere.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001300_LUCIA
134.description: Beasts have been sighted within the capital. Perhaps it was a stroke of grim fortune that the population was decimated beforehand, as they've yet to appear in any great number, but in time...

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001310_LUCIA
135.description: In any case, Maxima leads the remainder of the contingent in an effort to cull the creatures and evacuate the populace as we speak.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001320_LUCIA
136.description: Once the airships have taken to the skies, I pray your men can be persuaded to join him.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001330_JULLUS
137.description: You'll permit us to retain our weapons?

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001340_LUCIA
138.description: I wouldn't have sent you after the Scions were I expecting you to stab them in the back.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001350_ALPHINAUD
139.description: And I, for one, would not consider past transgressions more relevant than future contributions.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001360_ALPHINAUD
140.description: Regardless of the circumstances that saw us at odds before, we need men of courage now. More than ever.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001370_JULLUS
141.description: We swore to defend Garlemald. And so we shall.

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001380_FOURCHENAULT
142.description: It seems you have everything under control. You will excuse me, then, for mine own duties await.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001400_ALPHINAUD
144.description: You did desire to express your appreciation for services rendered, did you not?

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001410_FOURCHENAULT
145.description: I did... Though if you intend to again ask that Sharlayan alter its course, you will find my gratitude insufficient.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001430_ALPHINAUD
147.description: I wish to hear the details of this grand endeavor of yours.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001440_FOURCHENAULT
148.description: Do you swear to listen and to learn, and not to embark upon some scheme to impede us?

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001460_FOURCHENAULT
150.description: ...Hmph. Any other I would doubt, but you I trust to keep your word. For not once have you broken it.

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001470_FOURCHENAULT
151.description: Very well. I will request that the Forum make you privy to our plans. You may await our summons at the Baldesion Annex─assuming the decision is in your favor. Does that suffice?

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001480_ALPHINAUD
152.description: It does. You have my thanks.

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001490_GRAHATIA
153.description: Excellent! You can regale us with tales of your most recent sojourn to the First while we wait.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001520_PUDDINGWAY
156.description: Where, oh where, is this star's blasted pudding!?

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001540_URIANGER
158.description: Dawn may banish even the darkest night...

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001550_URIANGER
159.description: And to this bitter clime bring warmth and comfort.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001560_URIANGER
160.description: 'Tis heartening to see such an assembly upon my return. I thought often of you whilst I looked down upon our star's brilliance from the moon above.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001570_ALISAIE
161.description: Yes, but what are you doing here? And dressed like that! Aren't you cold?

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001580_URIANGER
162.description: Verily. I fear for my health should I proceed to expound upon our purpose ere I procure more suitable garments...

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001590_LIVINGWAY
163.description: Then allow me to summarize─we're here because none of you lot are up there! Nor has anyone deigned to send word about any changes in the plans!

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001600_LIVINGWAY
164.description: It's rude, is what it is. Least that's what I thought at first, but then folks got to wondering if you weren't in a spot of bother, so we decided to take matters into our own hands. Come down here and help, if our help be needed.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001610_MAPPINGWAY
165.description: So she says, but it's also something of a convenient excuse to visit Etheirys. Urianger made it sound absolutely marvelous. More so before the impending doom, but still.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001620_SINGINGWAY
166.description: And it's not like there will ever be a better time! What with the aforementioned doom.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001630_PUDDINGWAY
167.description: <hex:021A020203>Marvelous<hex:021A020103>, they say, yet not an onze of pudding to be found! I must suffer Urianger's inferior works no more...

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001640_LIVINGWAY
168.description: Hey! Maybe consider the plight of present company before you go blathering on about pudding and doom?

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001660_LIVINGWAY
170.description: As I was saying─should you require any assistance with...whatever, we are at your disposal.

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001670_LIVINGWAY
171.description: We were born from Hydaelyn's love for the lives of this star, so naturally we would much prefer to see them continue. Twiddling our thumbs up on the moon is hardly conducive to that, though, is it?

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001680_LIVINGWAY
172.description: Aye, not when you've all got such precious thoughts, and feelings, and hopes for the future, deserving of more active preservation. Speaking to Urianger made us realize that while we've carried out our duties to the letter, we've failed to fulfill them in spirit.

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001690_LIVINGWAY
173.description: From there it was just a hop, skip, and a jump towards resolving to do better! So please, show us how. Help us help you!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001720_LIVINGWAY
176.description: Hail fellow well met! You'd be a member of the Forum, would you? It's an honor and a pleasure to meet you at last.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001730_LIVINGWAY
177.description: I'm Livingway, Hydaelyn's right paw. That last bit is very important─as am I, if I may humbly say so myself.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001740_FOURCHENAULT
178.description: I, er...bid you welcome to our star, Livingway. On behalf of the Forum, I thank you for traveling such a distance to meet us.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001750_FOURCHENAULT
179.description: As you have surmised, preparations for the exodus have not proceeded as smoothly as we had hoped. I should be happy to personally escort you to our headquarters in Sharlayan, where you may advise us as you deem fit.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001760_URIANGER
180.description: 'Twas with reluctance that I set aside the great work of readying the moon for habitation. Be assured that I did so only after the Loporrits made plain their earnest desire to come hither, and I myself felt a growing certainty that their contributions here would prove invaluable.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001770_URIANGER
181.description: 'Tis trite, perhaps, but...I followed my heart.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
184.description: May thy disciples banish this darkest of nights.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001780_URIANGER
185.description: For a time, at least. Nevertheless, 'twas worth the journey to find present company well.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001800_URIANGER
187.description: I am no esteemed philosopher of eld. Nevertheless, 'tis my hope that what little knowledge I shared shall serve them well, and perchance help save us all.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001810_URIANGER
188.description: Wilt thou attend us at the Forum, and lend thine own wisdom?

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001820_ALISAIE
189.description: If that's all quite settled, can we start moving before Urianger catches his death? Even I'm freezing out here.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001830_GRAHATIA
190.description: Oh, I daresay you'll warm up quickly once you're aboard the airship, sat shoulder to shoulder with our fur-covered friends.

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001840_ALPHINAUD
191.description: There is a matter I wish to raise with you before we enter.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001850_ALPHINAUD
192.description: We are here to listen and to learn─but if the Forum's plans are more or less what I expect, then I should like to make a proposal that will serve our ends...

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001870_ALISAIE
194.description: I don't see why not. Your words and wits have gotten us this far.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001880_KRILE
195.description: Agreed. I will present our queries so that you may consider the most advantageous way to advance your proposal without distraction.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001900_BARNIER
197.description: If I may have your attention─the ad hoc session will now commence.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001910_BARNIER
198.description: The purpose of today's assembly is to brief the Scions of the Seventh Dawn, at their request, on the great exodus.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001930_BARNIER
200.description: On behalf of the Forum, I commend your heroic actions on the Magna Glacies. We shall not soon forget your service to us and the people of Radz-at-Han.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001940_BARNIER
201.description: The satrap, whom we have informed of the refugees' new arrangements, sings your praises as well.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001950_BARNIER
202.description: As an expression of our gratitude, we will endeavor to answer your questions as fully and openly as we are able.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001970_KRILE
204.description: First─it is the Forum's objective to ferry the life and knowledge of this star to the moon. Am I correct?

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001980_FOURCHENAULT
205.description: You are. It is for this purpose that Sharlayan has labored these many long years.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_001990_FOURCHENAULT
206.description: We have collected biological samples and scientific records from across the star. When the time comes, they will be moved from their places in Labyrinthos and Noumenon and conveyed to safety.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002000_FOURCHENAULT
207.description: Once that critical task has been accomplished, we will begin transporting the Sharlayan citizenry, which has been categorized into groups. The earliest arrivals are to ensure hospitable environs for those who come after.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002010_FOURCHENAULT
208.description: Following our people, we will send those of other nations in turn, beginning with our allies.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002020_FOURCHENAULT
209.description: Radz-at-Han was foremost among these, but since the Final Days have already come to Thavnair, we saw fit to include the refugees with earlier groupings.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002030_YSHTOLA
210.description: An ambitious plan. You have accounted for the safety of all nations and tribes, then?

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002050_YSHTOLA
212.description: And how, pray tell, do you decide who to leave behind?

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002060_FOURCHENAULT
213.description: To journey beyond the sky is an unprecedented and immeasurably difficult endeavor. Introducing sources of inevitable conflict would condemn all to certain death.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002070_KRILE
214.description: Questions as to the validity of that approach aside...

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002080_KRILE
215.description: Are your plans proceeding apace? We're under the impression that your primary means of celestial transportation is incomplete.

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002090_FOURCHENAULT
216.description: If only in that it does not meet our optimal parameters, that is correct.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002100_FOURCHENAULT
217.description: This ark, as some have taken to calling it, is fully operational and could be launched even today.

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002110_FOURCHENAULT
218.description: However, the Final Days have progressed more quickly than we anticipated.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002120_FOURCHENAULT
219.description: At present, the ship is incapable of attaining speeds sufficient to meet our evacuation targets.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002130_FOURCHENAULT
220.description: Should we put the vessel into service as it is now, we will be unable to travel to the moon and back quickly enough to complete the necessary number of trips. Precious lives and knowledge will be lost.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002140_ALISAIE
221.description: Seven hells... Is there anything to be done?

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002150_FOURCHENAULT
222.description: The aetherburner─the primary means of propulsion once the craft is in the space between stars─is undergoing testing to determine whether it can be made more efficient.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002160_FOURCHENAULT
223.description: Though cargo is being loaded for the initial phase of the exodus, we are prepared to continue our experimentation up to the day before launch should it prove necessary.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002170_ALPHINAUD
224.description: What if the Scions were to solve your problem?

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002180_ALPHINAUD
225.description: We shall help devise a means to improve the aetherburner's efficiency─on two conditions.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002190_ALPHINAUD
226.description: If we succeed, you must allow us to meet with Hydaelyn.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002200_YSHTOLA
227.description: 'Twas simple enough to deduce. You have a concord, and so you would never have abandoned the Antitower had you no other means of communication.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002210_YSHTOLA
228.description: One far more convenient, I suspect.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002220_ALPHINAUD
229.description: The second condition, also to be met upon our success, is that we be permitted to propose another use for your ark.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002230_FOURCHENAULT
230.description: We would be at liberty to refuse this proposal?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002240_ALPHINAUD
231.description: Of course. If we cannot prove its merit to the ninety-nine here, who are we to stake on it the lives of all peoples of this star?

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002250_MONTICHAIGNE
232.description: Hahaha! Delightful as always, Master Alphinaud!

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002260_MONTICHAIGNE
234.description: We couldn't have asked for a finer plan. “Allow us to solve this complex engineering problem of which we were entirely unaware until moments ago. What could possibly go wrong?” Haha! The satire writes itself!

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002270_MONTICHAIGNE
236.description: Yet what field has not benefited from a change in perspective? When we are at wits' end, what we need is not the same dry theories recited ad nauseam, but fresh inspiration.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002280_MONTICHAIGNE
237.description: I, for one, have faith in my erstwhile students to provide it. And I find their terms to be perfectly acceptable.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002290_BARNIER
238.description: Order! Order! We have no time to waste on debate. I call a vote.

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002300_BARNIER
239.description: All in favor of agreeing to the Scions' terms?

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002310_BARNIER
240.description: Seventy-one in favor, twenty-eight against. The ayes have it.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002320_BARNIER
241.description: Fourchenault, as the architect of this project, you are the best candidate to show them its current state. ...And bear in mind that, regardless of your personal misgivings, this is the will of the Forum.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002340_BARNIER
243.description: I call this session to a close. Return to your tasks with urgency─the Final Days wait for none.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002350_KOKKOLDANKKOL
244.description: I could swap 'em out... No─been there, done that, damn near lost me eyebrows...

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002360_KOKKOLDANKKOL
245.description: Think, Kokkol, think! We'd be well on our way to paradise, visionaries pattin' themselves on the backs for their grand accomplishments if you'd only <hex:021A020203>think<hex:021A020103>!

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002370_FOURCHENAULT
246.description: Yes... That does sound rather lovely...

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002380_KOKKOLDANKKOL
247.description: Gyaaah! ...I mean, Master Fourchenault, what a pleasant surprise! We're not blastin' off already, are we!?

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002390_FOURCHENAULT
248.description: The schedule remains unchanged. For better or worse...

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002400_FOURCHENAULT
249.description: Which is why the Forum has elected to accept assistance in resolving the aetherburner conundrum.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002410_KOKKOLDANKKOL
250.description: Huh. Not seen you lot down here before.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002420_FOURCHENAULT
251.description: There are Archons among their number, but engineering is not their expertise. Nevertheless, the Forum concedes the slim possibility that they may have insights to offer. If not, you are at liberty to return them to the surface...by whatever means you see fit.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002430_ALPHINAUD
252.description: I assure you that won't be necessary. Now, about your troubles with the aetherburner...?

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002440_KOKKOLDANKKOL
253.description: Aye, aye, I'll walk you through it. S'pose I could do with a change of pace.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002450_KOKKOLDANKKOL
254.description: As the name ought to tell you, the aetherburner “burns” aether─ambient or otherwise─and transforms it into motive force. Think of it like a giant bomb that never stops explodin'.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002460_KOKKOLDANKKOL
255.description: Even out in that black void where the aether's right sparse, it's strong enough to move our ark. And it probably won't kill you like an actual bomb!

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002480_KOKKOLDANKKOL
257.description: Accordin' to my calculations, to travel to the moon and back fast enough for the Forum's likin', the conversion rate needs to be six percent more efficient.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002490_KOKKOLDANKKOL
258.description: “A measly six percent,” you say, but if I could've squeezed even another “point six” out of it, don't you think I'd've built it that way in the first place!?

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002500_URIANGER
259.description: Hast thou consulted with the Loporrits?

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002510_FOURCHENAULT
260.description: Yes. They too are conducting their own research, for lack of a ready answer.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002520_FOURCHENAULT
261.description: The moon's propulsion systems are considerable, naturally, yet they are commensurately massive.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002530_FOURCHENAULT
262.description: It is no easy feat to convert their technology into an efficient means of propulsion for a “teeny-tiny toy boat,” as they say─and as I most certainly do not.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002540_KOKKOLDANKKOL
263.description: Yes, exactly! Damn it all, I ask for refined adamantite and they send me uppity rabbits with inscrutable, ancient, incompatible technology... You tryin' to drive me mad?

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002550_GRAHATIA
264.description: Do you speak of <hex:021A020203>Allagan<hex:021A020103>-refined adamantite, perchance?

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002570_GRAHATIA
266.description: Only in the most general terms, I'm afraid. 'Twas an alloy of Allagan make, but the secrets of its production were closely guarded.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002580_GRAHATIA
267.description: As I recall, the records stated it was vital to Dalamud's construction and launch.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002590_KOKKOLDANKKOL
268.description: Aye, that's the stuff! No material more conductive far as I know. Slottin' some in's like blowing up a dam and watching the river of aether come rushing through!

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002600_KOKKOLDANKKOL
269.description: Ain't a living soul that knows how to make it, though.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002610_KOKKOLDANKKOL
270.description: We were fortunate enough to salvage some for the aetherburner─just a wee bit, mind─from a chunk of Dalamud that came hurtlin' into the Northern Empty during the Calamity.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002620_KOKKOLDANKKOL
271.description: With more...well, that extra six percent efficiency would be child's play. It's a cryin' shame that we've no other sources.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002630_ALISAIE
272.description: Surely the many shards of Dalamud scattered throughout Eorzea would suffice. Why not get the refined adamantite from them?

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002640_KOKKOLDANKKOL
273.description: Oh we tried, believe you me. But only a few specialized pieces would've had any in 'em to begin with.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002650_KOKKOLDANKKOL
274.description: Drive cores from Ragnarok-class internment hulks─those are the prize bits we really need.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002660_KOKKOLDANKKOL
275.description: But accordin' to the gleaners, gettin' to 'em means delvin' deep into the shards─and the defenses are still very operational and very eager to blow 'em up.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002670_KOKKOLDANKKOL
276.description: It's rough goin' in there, even for the cream. Not sure they'd make it out alive...

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002680_ALISAIE
277.description: ...Weren't we near that part of the <hex:021A020203>Ragnarok<hex:021A020103> when we went to destroy Bahamut?

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
279.description: You want me to go and fetch the wotsits?

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
280.description: The White Raven's ghost...it haunts me...

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A3_000_003_NONE_VOICE
281.description: This sounds like a job for someone else.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002690_ALISAIE
282.description: That may be for the best...though you'd doubtless find the task too dull for your liking.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002700_ALISAIE
283.description: Heavens, are you alright? You look pale as a...well!

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002710_ALISAIE
284.description: Best put that battle from your mind for now. Deep breaths, that's it...

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002730_ALPHINAUD
286.description: Hmm... There are multiple internment hulks in Eorzea alone, so handling this ourselves may not be the most efficient option.

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002740_ALPHINAUD
287.description: Rather, if we could salvage adamantite from the shards simultaneously...

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002750_ALPHINAUD
288.description: Thancred, is the linkshell we established before you went to Garlemald still active?

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002760_THANCRED
289.description: Of course. The floor is yours.

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002780_ALPHINAUD
291.description: Gathering firewood, so to speak. We alone can accomplish little, but joined by others, we may yet build a bonfire to carry us heavensward.

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002790_ALPHINAUD
292.description: This is Alphinaud. The Scions have need of you.

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002800_LUCIA
293.description: (-Lucia-)Understood. I will contact the Lord Commander and dispatch our finest at once.

294.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002810_ARUHNSENNA
294.description: (-A-Ruhn-Senna-)My sisters are somewhat preoccupied with the Final Days─so I will lead the Twelveswood expedition myself.

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002820_YSHTOLA
295.description: Are you aware of any other sources of refined adamantite?

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002830_GRAHATIA
296.description: Logically, such an invaluable alloy would have been utilized solely where absolutely necessary─in components intended to conduct or collect surpassing amounts of aether.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002840_GRAHATIA
297.description: Any extant instrumentation or devices would have likely found their way into the hands of aetherologists or...enthusiasts.

298.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002850_CIRINA
298.description: (-Cirina-)Magical artifacts of Allagan design? The Eastern alliance will send word to one and all.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002860_CIRINA
299.description: (-Cirina-)Are there other ways we may offer aid? No shards of the lesser moon scar our soil, but our stake in this cause is no less for it...

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002870_ALPHINAUD
300.description: Is there anything in Othard that might be of use to you?

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002880_KOKKOLDANKKOL
301.description: Othard, you say!? You've got friends in far places, lad!

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002890_KOKKOLDANKKOL
302.description: Anyroad, if you're offerin', I wouldn't say no to one of those Far Eastern sacred relics.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002900_KOKKOLDANKKOL
303.description: Some of them can hold enough aether to summon a whole damn primal. Combine a source like that with the aetherburner and three...two...one...kaboom!

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002910_ALPHINAUD
304.description: ...I gather you heard his explosive enthusiasm. Might you secure us a suitable relic?

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002920_CIRINA
305.description: (-Cirina-)It shall be done! I know little of machines, but I promise we will do our utmost to gather the materials you need to finish your starship.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002930_CIRINA
306.description: (-Cirina-)I am glad for the work, in truth. Better to busy oneself than wait and fret over disasters foretold.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002940_SICARD
307.description: (-Sicard-)Then why're we all still standin' about yappin'? There's plunder for the takin'─an' I'm a born plunderer!

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002950_SICARD
308.description: (-Sicard-)I'll be in Ol' Sharlayan before you know it. Start mixing the grog!

309.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002960_ALPHINAUD
309.description: I'm certain that can be arranged. Thank you all─and do be careful.

311.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002980_ALPHINAUD
311.description: Aye, just like that, our refined adamantite is on its way.

312.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_002990_ALPHINAUD
312.description: Now let us consider our next steps, shall we? There's yet much to be done.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003010_NANAMOULNAMO
314.description: ...Our course of action is clear. We must harvest refined adamantite from the shards of Dalamud, and procure arcane relics of Allagan make.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003020_NANAMOULNAMO
315.description: Summon the best and brightest of our Immortal Flames, and form an expeditionary party at once! Call upon the Sultansworn and Brass Blades for support as you must.

316.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003030_NANAMOULNAMO
316.description: Papashan, send word to the guilds. We will require the expertise of master artisans if we are to have any hope of identifying and recovering these elusive materials.

317.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003040_NANAMOULNAMO
317.description: Fyrgeiss, we have need of your Stone Torches.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003050_NANAMOULNAMO
318.description: They are to assist the Immortal Flames in scouring the ruins, and to help secure the surrounding areas. I trust I can count on your support?

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003060_FYRGEISS
319.description: As commander of the Stone Torches, my son Zirnberk will personally see it done.

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003070_NANAMOULNAMO
320.description: Pipin. I would have you lead the raiding party. Assemble your finest, and with Tizona's blade clear the way.

321.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003080_NANAMOULNAMO
321.description: Lord Lolorito, I pray you take charge of the search for Allagan relics. Surely you know of some being traded on open or clandestine markets, or sleeping in collectors' vaults.

322.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003090_NANAMOULNAMO
322.description: Of course, I ask not that you do this out of the kindness of your heart. By all means, profit on the transactions. I wish you the joy of it.

323.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003100_NANAMOULNAMO
323.description: The Final Days descend upon our world. If circumstances are truly as dire as they say, Ul'dah's best efforts may be for naught.

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003110_NANAMOULNAMO
324.description: And yet, when we Eorzeans rose from the ashes to rebuild our broken realm, did we not learn one simple truth?

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003120_NANAMOULNAMO
325.description: That which seems all but impossible to overcome alone, may yet be possible if we stand together.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003130_NANAMOULNAMO
326.description: It was the Scions who united us then, and it is the Scions who call upon us now.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003140_NANAMOULNAMO
327.description: Ul'dah will answer that call. We will summon our courage, and join the fight for our world's future.

328.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003150_NANAMOULNAMO
328.description: You know your duties! I, Nanamo Ul Namo, seventeenth in the line of Ul, bid you good luck and godsspeed!

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003170_ARUHNSENNA
330.description: We've fielded a goodly number, but our ranks are heavy with healers. And an abundance of restorative magicks will be of little help in destroying Dalamud's defenses.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003180_ARUHNSENNA
331.description: Still, it has ever been thus with Gridania. We must steel ourselves for a protracted engagement...

332.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003190_LYSE
332.description: (-???-)In that case, might I suggest taking us along?

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003200_ARUHNSENNA
333.description: Commander Hext!? What are you doing here?

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003210_LYSE
334.description: None of the shards in Gyr Abania are big enough to hold an internment hulk.

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003220_LYSE
335.description: So we said to ourselves─why not lend our neighbors a hand? We thought you might be short on people with a talent for breaking things.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003230_ARUHNSENNA
336.description: While it pains me to admit it...you are right. Are our deficiencies so plain to see?

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003240_LYSE
337.description: It might've been a lifetime ago, but I was once one of the Scions assigned to the Shroud.

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003250_LYSE
338.description: I know this forest well. I know your people. And I know we will be stronger if we fight this fight together.

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003260_ARUHNSENNA
339.description: Then I will impose upon you with a clear conscience. Come, let us speak of how to integrate our forces.

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003270_LYSE
340.description: I won't let it all be for nothing. I promise you, Papalymo...

343.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003300_EMMANELLAIN
343.description: We've no time to waste, Brother! Everyone has already... Ah.

344.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003310_EMMANELLAIN
344.description: That...that was a roar. A dragon's roar!

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003330_HANCOCK
346.description: ...And so, in summation, the Eastern alliance, as well as the honorable Lord Lolorito himself, reached out to me for assistance in procuring these treasures of the divine─and I, in turn, do beseech the Confederacy for aid.

348.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003350_SOROBAN
348.description: Hancock? What a surprise this is!

349.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003360_SOROBAN
349.description: And a fortuitous one at that. I have a favor to ask, you see...

350.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003370_LIVINGWAY
350.description: Phew! Finally, some rest. Why, I haven't spoken so much in...well, in forever!

351.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003380_THANCRED
351.description: Lively, isn't it? The town is abuzz─everyone eager to meet with our friends from the moon.

352.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003390_URIANGER
352.description: 'Twould behoove you to consult with Sleepingway. As our moon's pilot, his advice should be most pertinent...

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003400_THANCRED
353.description: I'm impressed. Truth be told, I struggle to tell one from another. No offense intended, of course...

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003410_LIVINGWAY
354.description: None taken! After you and your friends left Mare Lamentorum, we spent no small amount of time with your Urianger.

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003420_LIVINGWAY
355.description: Oh, the conversations we had! He told us all about Etheirys─answered our every question, no matter how trifling or trivial.

356.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003430_LIVINGWAY
356.description: Look! Every page, filled to the margins with knowledge!

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003440_LIVINGWAY
357.description: When I first arrived, I was struck by how little I knew. It was daunting...but then I realized that were it not for Urianger and his teachings, we'd still be stuck on the moon. Gazing at your world and wondering what we've been missing...

359.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003460_THANCRED
359.description: What would they think if they could see Urianger now? I daresay they'd be more than a bit surprised...and impressed, no doubt.

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003470_THANCRED
360.description: Master Louisoix, Minfilia, Papalymo. And not to forget...

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003480_WILFSUNN
361.description: Ho there! Heard there was a visiting expert who we might bother with a few questions. I take it you'd be the one?

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003500_THANCRED
363.description: Wilfsunn and Bloewyda. Sharlayan's foremost researchers in the field of teleportation magick. ...And Moenbryda's parents.

364.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003510_URIANGER
364.description: It hath been some time. 'Tis... 'Tis good to see you in...good health.

365.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003520_WILFSUNN
365.description: Likewise, old friend! Bloewyda and I were most honored to answer the call. Never expected this reunion, though, did we, dear?

366.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003530_BLOEWYDA
366.description: I'll say! The nerve...sending that letter, then running off to the gods know where!

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003540_BLOEWYDA
367.description: Do you have...any idea...how worried we were?

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003560_URIANGER
369.description: I...I'm sorry. 'Twas remiss of me...not to deliver the news in person.

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003570_URIANGER
370.description: No, more than that... 'Twas I who...

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003580_WILFSUNN
371.description: Our daughter was disillusioned after Master Louisoix left her behind. The day the Scions called upon her was the happiest I'd seen her in years.

372.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003590_WILFSUNN
372.description: She made her every choice of her own free will. No one could've ever forced her to do otherwise.

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003600_WILFSUNN
373.description: Don't blame yourself for her death. Celebrate her life. You know that's what she'd want.

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003610_BLOEWYDA
374.description: If there is one thing we resent you for, it was that we could not be there to mourn her with you...

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003620_BLOEWYDA
375.description: Reading the words you penned in that shaky hand... We must have cried as much for you as we did for her.

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003630_URIANGER
376.description: I'm sorry. I truly, truly am...

377.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003640_URIANGER
377.description: I knew not what to say. Knew not how to express my feelings...

378.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003650_URIANGER
378.description: The poems and platitudes of wiser men. Musings on sadness and loss... Studied and memorized...and meaningless in the moment.

379.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003660_BLOEWYDA
379.description: Silly boy... We are all powerless before such grief. Even now, try as I might, the words escape me...

380.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003670_BLOEWYDA
380.description: But in our hearts, we know. We always know.

381.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003680_WILFSUNN
381.description: I remember when you were young. How the lads teased you for choosing the company of books over others.

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003690_WILFSUNN
382.description: Our Moen didn't take kindly to that. “Be nice to Urianger!” she'd shout, and give them a walloping. No matter how many times we scolded her...

383.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003700_BLOEWYDA
383.description: So we offered a suggestion: rather than starting fights, why don't you be the bridge between Urianger and the others? She had to mull it over for a while. Arms crossed, brow furrowed in intense thought...

384.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003710_BLOEWYDA
384.description: But from that day on, she never let you be alone. She'd drag you outside to play, pepper you with endless questions, read the same books you read...all to try and understand you that much better.

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003720_BLOEWYDA
385.description: I'm sure it was annoying and exhausting at the time...but she only ever had the best of intentions.

386.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003730_WILFSUNN
386.description: And look at you now. At the center of the crowd─the reason there even is a crowd, having brought these people together.

387.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003740_WILFSUNN
387.description: You've no idea how proud we are.

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003750_BLOEWYDA
388.description: To see the boy our daughter trusted and believed in more than anyone...grow into the man she always knew he could be.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003760_BLOEWYDA
389.description: I can see her in you, too. Feel her. She walks with you, wheresoever you go. So thank you, Urianger. For being who you are.

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003780_URIANGER
391.description: I...I think...I can feel her, too...

392.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003790_URIANGER
392.description: The truth...of her life. Not sorrow...but hope. And love...

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003800_LIVINGWAY
393.description: This Moenbryda...she was important to him, wasn't she?

395.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003820_LIVINGWAY
395.description: Oh no, no. But watching this exchange reminds me how much I've yet to learn about your world...and its people.

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003830_THANCRED
396.description: You can live here your entire life and hardly learn a thing.

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003840_THANCRED
397.description: That's why...it's too soon for this to end.

399.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003860_ESTINIEN
399.description: We've finished what we could. Delivered supplies, tracked down escaped animals...trivial tasks as they may be.

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003870_ALISAIE
400.description: That's enough, don't you think? If there was anything more important still undone, that would be a problem in itself.

401.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003880_GRAHATIA
401.description: The vessel is essentially ready for departure. All that remains is to load the final batch of supplies and see everyone on board. Once we've readied the aetherburner, that is...

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003890_THANCRED
402.description: Ah...had a feeling we might find you all here.

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003900_URIANGER
403.description: Our consultations with the Loporrits, too, have run their course. Pleased I am to say that our researchers' concerns have for the most part been allayed, though some insist on making adjustments to the very end.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003910_URIANGER
404.description: For their part, Livingway and her peers have graciously offered to stay and keep the people company, lest any lingering queries go unanswered.

405.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003920_THANCRED
405.description: All that remains is to wait for the refined adamantite...

406.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003930_KRILE
406.description: (-Krile-)Alphinaud, are you there? It's me, Krile.

407.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003940_KRILE
407.description: (-Krile-)Your special delivery has arrived! Round up everyone and come to the harbor at once!

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003950_ALPHINAUD
408.description: Speak of the devil... Let us go at once!

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003960_OFFICECLERK
409.description: Forgive the intrusion, Master Fourchenault─I bring urgent news!

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003970_OFFICECLERK
410.description: A great commotion has broken out in Scholar's Harbor. Your presence is requested with all speed!

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_003980_ALPHINAUD
411.description: Now, where might this delivery be?

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004000_IMMIGRATIONCONTROLSTAFF
413.description: I'm sure it's very important, but we cannot accept these without the proper permits!

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004010_ALISAIE
414.description: By the Twelve! Surely these can't all be...

415.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004020_KOKKOLDANKKOL
415.description: Bleedin' hellfire! They're bringin' 'em by sea <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> by air! All these folks and these crates...

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004030_SICARD
416.description: And more on the way. Got your adamantite right here─a bigger haul than any o' these sorry bastards brought, and that's no lie!

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004040_EMMANELLAIN
417.description: Yes, because you were charged with seeing the shipments from Gridania and Ul'dah here along with your own. Give credit where credit is due.

418.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004050_SICARD
418.description: Sounds like the sorry whingin' of a sore loser─an' a hypocrite to boot. Ain't no way a scrawny whelp like you took a dozen steps inside a Dalamud shard.

419.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004060_EMMANELLAIN
419.description: I'll have you know I went all the way to the entrance! Furthermore, 'twas my contacts that enabled us to enlist the cooperation of the sky pirates.

420.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004070_EMMANELLAIN
420.description: I'll have you know I went all the way to the entrance! I played a vital role in keeping a lookout whilst our expeditionary forces secured the adamantite.

421.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004080_SICARD
421.description: Left you outside so you wouldn't get anyone killed, did they? Well then, credit where credit's due─you did a right fine job sittin' on your arse!

424.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004110_EMMANELLAIN
424.description: I will not stoop to your level!

425.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004120_HANCOCK
425.description: My, what a grand welcome party!

427.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004140_HANCOCK
427.description: We come bearing relics both sacred and Allagan─as well as a few other gifts that may be of help─to be presented with best wishes from the Eastern alliance.

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004150_HANCOCK
428.description: Our friends in Bozja, for instance, have sent along a few artifacts for the “brave allies of the Resistance.” That's you!

429.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004160_HANCOCK
429.description: And we've brought a number of items from Eureka as well, courtesy of one Ejika Tsunjika! He says, “A little advance warning would have been appreciated,” by the by.

430.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004170_HANCOCK
430.description: And we've brought a number of items from Eureka as well, courtesy of our hardworking expedition members!

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004180_SOROBAN
431.description: I myself have come with a sacred relic of Reisen Temple. 'Twas passing fortunate that Senri's dango craving brought us to Kugane─we arrived precisely as Hancock was making his arrangements.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004190_SOROBAN
432.description: Upon learning of your need, we made haste back to Hells' Lid─with our dango, never fear─and consulted with the other auspices. All consented to the lending of Tenzen's legendary Phoenix Blade for this noble cause.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004200_SOROBAN
433.description: Suzaku and Seiryu were nevertheless worried that it might be lost in transit, however, and insisted upon accompanying me to Onokoro, where I had intended to entrust it to our Confederate allies.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004210_SOROBAN
434.description: I thought instead to give it over to Hancock when we chanced to cross paths yet again, but alas, Seiryu remained ill at ease, and ordered me see the blade into your hands personally “or die trying”...

435.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004220_SOROBAN
435.description: I myself have come with a sacred relic of the Kojin. Upon learning of your need, Bunchin bade me deliver it on behalf of the Blue with all haste.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004230_SOROBAN
436.description: Fearing I could not swim here with the necessary speed, however, I thought to beg our Confederate allies for aid. To my delight, Hancock was already preparing for departure at the selfsame port, and had space for additional cargo.

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004240_HANCOCK
437.description: We did, of course, need quite the impressive vessel to get it all here in time.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004250_HANCOCK
438.description: Fortunately, our Majestic associates have been more than helpful. “'Tis an honor to join the Warrior of Light on another adventure,” they tell me!

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004260_ALPHINAUD
439.description: That is all wonderful to hear, but what of the extraordinary cost? I shudder to think of the ransom we must pay for such a bounty...

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004270_HANCOCK
440.description: Fret not for your coinpurse, young Alphinaud!

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004280_HANCOCK
441.description: Lord Lolorito looks ever towards the profits of the future, and thus the East Aldenard Trading Company went to some lengths to reduce the financial liability.

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004290_HANCOCK
442.description: And since the Scions funded the entire venture, not a gil need be rendered up in compensation. Everything is already yours!

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004320_TATARU
445.description: (-???-)Don't let the name fool you─this <hex:021A020203>coinkeeper<hex:021A020103> knows a thing or two about spending.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004330_TATARU
446.description: When it comes to capital investiture, a sprinkling of gil here and there will not do! You need enough savings to make waves when it really counts...which is why frugality is paramount.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004340_TATARU
447.description: We also had the benefit of a generous patron─“generous” being rather an understatement...

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004350_TATARU
448.description: She has supported us from the shadows since the very founding of the Scions, ere we even had coffers to fill...

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004380_AMELIANCE
451.description: I remain, of course, an entirely neutral party. I simply thought our family's coffers were needlessly full.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004390_AMELIANCE
452.description: We can hardly take them with us on your “teeny-tiny toy boat,” now, can we? And 'twould be a shame to leave all that hard-earned wealth unspent.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004420_THANCRED
455.description: How ever did you manage so much in so short a time, though? We expected word to reach only a fraction of our allies...

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004430_KRILE
456.description: Did I not tell you I have my ways?

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004450_ERENVILLE
458.description: I received a letter from Krile after we parted ways in Labyrinthos.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004460_ERENVILLE
459.description: She explained what the Scions were trying to accomplish, and why you might soon require the services of the gleaners, spread across the world as we are.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004470_ERENVILLE
460.description: I pray you do not interpret this as a betrayal of Sharlayan. I accept that the Forum's aim in pushing us to our limits was to preserve what knowledge we have, and I bear you no ill will for it.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004480_ERENVILLE
461.description: Yet, in collecting that knowledge, what I came to appreciate most about our star is that there remains so much we do not know.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004490_ERENVILLE
462.description: That is why I chose to help the Scions─to combat the obliteration of those countless undiscovered wonders. I held no illusions that they would be less demanding taskmasters...though rest assured, if I had, I would have been sorely disappointed.

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004500_ERENVILLE
463.description: To make a long story short─the whole of the guildship cooperated to ensure your call was heard far and wide.

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004510_CID
464.description: What's this about a ship that can fly to the moon?

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004520_CID
465.description: And why didn't you mention it sooner? The one time you don't beg my aid, your problem's a bloody ship that can fly to the moon!

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004540_CID
467.description: Of course! Garlond Ironworks' finest. You need only point us towards my new favorite ship...

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004550_CID
468.description: Oh, I nearly forgot. We stopped by Werlyt before coming here and picked up a package from Gaius.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004560_CID
469.description: He's still of the mind that actions make for better penance than words─contrite or otherwise─so he offered none of the latter.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004570_CID
470.description: What he sent is an Allagan relic Valens used in his Weapons experiments─has a fair bit of refined adamantite in it, too.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004580_HOARYBOULDER
471.description: As you like as not suspect, we've also brought adamantite from Mor Dhona's Dalamud shard.

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004590_HOARYBOULDER
472.description: I admit to some consternation upon first receiving Krile's message. So few Scions remain at the Rising Stones now─far too few for such an expedition.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004600_HOARYBOULDER
473.description: However, the gleaners were able to secure us reinforcements, Idyllshire's treasure hunters not least among them.

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004610_HOARYBOULDER
474.description: And ho, how the gobbieflock fought!

475.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004620_HOARYBOULDER
475.description: Slowfix's gratitude for the safe return of his daughter has not waned, and he gathered his kin to our side with an astounding quickness.

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004630_HOARYBOULDER
476.description: The clash between their machina and the Allagan defenses was a sight to behold. I wager even you would have been impressed by the magnitude of the gobbiebooms!

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004640_ESTINIEN
477.description: Fascinating as all this is, I fail to see how it explains your presence here. Does Radz-at-Han not have more pressing concerns?

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004650_VARSHAHN
478.description: We do─yet averting the Final Days would be the most expedient solution. That, and I am indebted to you.

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004660_VARSHAHN
479.description: Though they chose to take their leave of Thavnair, those you saved in Garlemald remain my people. My gratitude is beyond words.

480.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004670_VARSHAHN
480.description: 'Tis appropriate that I aid you in kind. If in the doing we bring salvation to others of this star, so much the better.

481.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004680_VARSHAHN
481.description: You will recall that I spoke of my father, Midgardsormr, and his journey across the great expanse.

482.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004690_VARSHAHN
482.description: As he traveled betwixt the stars, his resplendent scales drank of the aether in those nigh-empty surrounds, and imparted to him the strength to persevere...

483.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004700_VARSHAHN
483.description: Thinking they might further your cause, I called out to my kin for consent.

484.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004710_VARSHAHN
484.description: Azdaja's answer was silence, as ever.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004720_VARSHAHN
485.description: Tiamat and Hraesvelgr, however, responded favorably to the suggestion.

486.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004730_VARSHAHN
486.description: My sire, too, stirred from his slumber long enough to speak and say, “Very well...”

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004740_VARSHAHN
487.description: My sire, too, gave his assent.

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004750_VARSHAHN
488.description: Thus have I brought you his own wyrmscales. Fit them to your purpose, and seek a worthier fate for us all.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004760_NIDHANA
489.description: You'd be hard-pressed to find someone else so familiar with the unique properties of dragon scales, so I invited myself along.

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004770_KOKKOLDANKKOL
490.description: Bugger me, this is so unbelievable I've gone right back round to believin' it again!

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004780_KOKKOLDANKKOL
491.description: Forget a six percent gain in efficiency. With all these goodies, we could get seven─no, ten─no! <hex:021A020203>Fourteen<hex:021A020103> bleedin' percent!

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004790_KOKKOLDANKKOL
492.description: Think of how far we could go─what we could do with that much power! What we could blow up!

493.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004800_BARNIER
493.description: If Kokkol is duly convinced, then it must be true─in which case, the Scions' end of the bargain has been fulfilled. Would you not agree?

495.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004820_FOURCHENAULT
495.description: I know not what you seek of Hydaelyn, nor for what purpose you would take command of our ship.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004830_FOURCHENAULT
496.description: Yet this much is certain─to do so will be to dictate the fate of this star and the lives upon it.

497.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004840_FOURCHENAULT
497.description: The lives of each and every creature. In their magnitude and their fragility.

498.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004850_FOURCHENAULT
498.description: Do you understand, and are you prepared?

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004860_ALPHINAUD
499.description: We have seen and we have felt how much each life shapes this world. And so we are determined to abandon none. We understand what is at stake, and we are prepared to bear this burden.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004880_FOURCHENAULT
501.description: Then I... I will bear it with you.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004890_FOURCHENAULT
502.description: I beg you─share your struggles with me. As family.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004900_FOURCHENAULT
503.description: You grasped my fingers with such tiny hands the day you were born. I thought my heart might burst.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004910_FOURCHENAULT
504.description: 'Twas love and happiness beyond expression. Overwhelming. And a conviction so powerful that I trembled with something close to rage.

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004920_FOURCHENAULT
505.description: I had heard the Final Days foretold. I swore to myself then and there that I would not let them steal your futures.

506.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004930_FOURCHENAULT
506.description: The great exodus would succeed. Must succeed. No sacrifice or sin was worse than the alternative.

507.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004940_FOURCHENAULT
507.description: If anything gave me pause...'twas mine own father.

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004950_FOURCHENAULT
508.description: The Archon Louisoix openly decried Sharlayan's policies, a perspective which I regarded with increasing disdain as I grew older.

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004960_FOURCHENAULT
509.description: Yet even as part of me thought him a fool... Perhaps I also hoped that he, of all people, would devise a brilliant means to save my children.

510.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004970_FOURCHENAULT
510.description: A naive hope─but stubborn enough that I could never bring myself to keep you apart.

511.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004980_FOURCHENAULT
511.description: No, that was his doing, when he perished at Carteneau.

512.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_004990_FOURCHENAULT
512.description: As we pulled that twisted slab of Dalamud from the sea, I remembered the warmth of your newborn touch. Chastened, I vowed never again to suffer any interference in my mission to protect you.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005000_FOURCHENAULT
513.description: No matter that you yourselves wished otherwise.

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005010_FOURCHENAULT
514.description: Detest me. Fight me tooth and nail. I would suffer it and more and be satisfied so long as I could force you onto the ship.

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005020_FOURCHENAULT
515.description: I was wrong. You two have grown so much stronger, and so much wiser, than I dared dream.

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005030_FOURCHENAULT
516.description: You have earned the right to walk your own path...and already begun to do so.

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005040_ALISAIE
517.description: Good! Because there are things we care about, and people we love...and none of them is replaceable. Not a one.

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005050_FOURCHENAULT
518.description: It cannot have been an easy journey, for you to have come so far.

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005060_ALPHINAUD
519.description: We shall be glad to acquaint you with the finer details someday, once this danger has passed. All that we have seen and heard. That we have felt and learned in our travels.

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005070_ALPHINAUD
520.description: Ours is not a kind world, but it is beautiful. Always.

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005080_AMELIANCE
521.description: Oh no, are you quite sure that's wise? After all, <hex:021A020203>someone<hex:021A020103> turns pale and flees the room when he sees so much as an envelope containing word of your adventures.

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005090_AMELIANCE
522.description: What ever will happen if he learns what you were really up to?

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005130_FOURCHENAULT
526.description: Though I have wronged my children most gravely, I owe you an apology as well.

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005140_FOURCHENAULT
527.description: I assumed that it was the Scions' influence that made them so keen to charge headlong into danger.

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005155_FOURCHENAULT
529.description: I see now that said influence instead brought them together with the many fine people gathered here today.

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005160_FOURCHENAULT
530.description: In which case...I hope you continue to guide them.

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005170_GRAHATIA
531.description: If we've finished loitering about the harbor, might I suggest we put our plans into motion? People are beginning to look confused.

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005180_ALPHINAUD
532.description: Perhaps you can spare a few words ere they resume the tedious lugging of cargo? You've no small number of friends and admirers here, after all.

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
535.description: Our moment of triumph is close at hand!

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005270_FOURCHENAULT
545.description: Your assistance is appreciated. Now, in an orderly fashion, if you please!

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005280_AMON
546.description: So bold, so headstrong. Stubborn to the last.

547.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005290_AMON
547.description: But this is as far as you go. Oblivion beckons!

549.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005310_AMON
549.description: Your dreams, your hopes, your futures... Delusions and lies!

551.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005330_AMON
551.description: My very essence...begins to wane. Sweet, sweet agony...

553.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005350_AMON
553.description: Come to deal the coup de grâce?

554.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005360_AMON
554.description: Good... Watching you struggle against the inevitable is bad comedy. Erase me from existence, soul and all.

556.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A5_000_001_NONE_VOICE
556.description: Have you any memories of Meteion?

557.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A5_000_002_NONE_VOICE
557.description: Do you recall your days as Hermes?

558.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005370_AMON
558.description: How would you know that name?

560.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005390_AMON
560.description: Then it was you─in Elpis, with Emet-Selch. Ha! The final pieces fall into place.

561.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005400_AMON
561.description: In my halcyon days as the mortal Amon, I was haunted by a dream...

562.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005410_AMON
562.description: Night after night, the faceless multitude. The voiceless cries. Shards of shattered memories.

563.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005420_AMON
563.description: But slowly the fog began to clear. This was Elpis, and I...I was Hermes.

564.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005430_AMON
564.description: Recurring though it was, I paid this dream little heed.

565.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005440_AMON
565.description: It was only when I was granted the seat─and memories─of Fandaniel that I knew these visions to be true.

566.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005450_AMON
566.description: They were the memories of Hermes, that he himself erased using the power of Kairos.

567.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005460_AMON
567.description: Or so he thought. In his attempt to burn away the events of that fateful day, he succeeded only in searing them more deeply into his soul. My soul.

568.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005470_AMON
568.description: Death failed to expunge them, no matter how many times it came. Rebirth after rebirth, from one Fandaniel to the next.

569.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005480_AMON
569.description: I wonder─is Emet-Selch adrift somewhere in this aetherial sea, in defeat finally remembering your time together in Elpis?

570.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005490_AMON
570.description: How it must gall him─to be entrusted with knowledge of the Final Days, only to be rendered powerless to act upon it! So many lifetimes dedicated to restoring his beloved Amaurot in blissful ignorance. Oh, folly.

571.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005500_AMON
571.description: But make no mistake... My life as Hermes is not the reason I invited the world's end.

572.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005510_AMON
572.description: I have lived. I have struggled. I have dredged the very depths of despair. And in the detritus of existence, I found the truth.

573.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005520_AMON
573.description: I served a great ruler, powerful beyond measure, the world his dominion. Yet even he and his vast empire were destined to fall─to become one with oblivion. At the end of life's journey...lies only death.

574.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005530_AMON
574.description: So I ask you─why live at all?

575.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005540_AMON
575.description: We betray, we torment, we murder. We are wicked, spiteful creatures─without exception!

576.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005550_AMON
576.description: If life is so sacred, so precious, why fill it with such misery?

577.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005560_AMON
577.description: Man wallows in a hell of his own making, without purpose or meaning.

578.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005570_AMON
578.description: To live is to suffer... And I would end that suffering by my own hand!

579.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005580_AMON
579.description: It matters not if it flies in the face of all believed right and just. Death is the only solution!

580.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005590_AMON
580.description: That is my truth. My answer to the question, and yet...

581.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005600_AMON
581.description: ...Even as the words pass my lips, I am filled with doubt.

582.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005610_AMON
582.description: Has my search reached its end?

585.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005640_AMON
585.description: Is this the answer I was hoping for?

586.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005650_ASAHI
586.description: (-???-)The lamentations of the damned... How it vexes me, to see your conviction falter at the last.

587.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005660_ASAHI
587.description: (-???-)Fandaniel... Still clinging to existence, I see.

588.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005670_ASAHI
588.description: (-???-)You, who champion death so fervently, unwilling to accept your own. Refusing to be purified and swept into the sea of souls─as do I.

589.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005680_ASAHI
589.description: (-???-)We prisoners to memory, watching as the world turns...

590.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005690_ASAHI
590.description: (-???-)Though unlike me, you will be spared the ignominy of having your corpse made a puppet, dancing to another's tune.

592.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005710_ASAHI
592.description: How very astute. But let me be clear─I have not come to consort with the likes of you.

593.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005720_ASAHI
593.description: Nor have I come to bemoan the state of the world following my untimely demise. In fact, I delight in mankind's downfall and the anguish it brings the savior of the savages.

594.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005730_ASAHI
594.description: If I played some small part in the chaos, all the better. Not that I was in any position to resist.

595.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005740_ASAHI
595.description: But to be made accomplice to the betrayal of Lord Zenos...

596.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005750_ASAHI
596.description: ...I would die a thousand deaths to exact my vengeance!

597.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005760_ASAHI
597.description: Now you are at my mercy. I shall drag us both into oblivion, and you will never see the fulfillment of your magnum opus!

598.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005770_ASAHI
598.description: Even should you be reborn, your desperate search for answers must start again!

600.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
600.description: I'll do what must be done.

602.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A6_000_003_NONE_VOICE
602.description: Next time, we will find the answer together.

603.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005780_AMON
603.description: Heh... And what might that be?

604.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005790_AMON
604.description: My wish is all but granted─to die and take you all with me.

607.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005820_AMON
607.description: You have every right to hate me. For the fool I was, for the monster I became.

608.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005830_AMON
