608.description: But I will not beg forgiveness. The tale of Hermes─the man who knew so much, yet understood so little─ends here.

609.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005840_ASAHI
609.description: Don't try to follow me. I had more of you people than I could stomach in life, never mind in death.

610.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005850_ALPHINAUD
610.description: Likewise. I pray we do not meet again.

611.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005860_ASAHI
611.description: Hmph. You had better hope not.

618.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005900_HYDAELYN
618.description: I see... Thou didst journey unto Elpis.

619.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005910_HYDAELYN
619.description: And now, the rivers of time converge.

620.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005920_HYDAELYN
620.description: I know why you have come, yet I would hear you speak your reasons, all the same.

621.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005930_ALISAIE
621.description: You created the moon to deliver mankind from the Final Days.

622.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005940_ALISAIE
622.description: But is that really how it has to end? We do not wish to abandon this world. We want to protect the Source, and all of its shards!

623.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005950_HYDAELYN
623.description: To flee is but one of two paths.

624.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005960_HYDAELYN
624.description: The other leadeth to Meteion, far beyond the stars, where she doth chant creation's requiem.

625.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005970_HYDAELYN
625.description: Her domain is formed of dynamis. Pure. Absolute.

626.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005980_HYDAELYN
626.description: Where emotion and memory govern all, aether will avail you naught.

627.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_005990_HYDAELYN
627.description: Meteion hath gathered the pain and despair of countless stars, and to go unprepared is to go unto your doom.

628.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006000_ALISAIE
628.description: We'll beat her. We'll win. I swear it!

630.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006020_ALISAIE
630.description: After everything I've seen, all the times I've succumbed to my own anger and fear...

631.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006030_ALISAIE
631.description: ...I can no longer pretend that courage and faith will be enough.

632.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006040_ALISAIE
632.description: But are we truly so powerless? That our only choice is to flee?

634.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006060_HYDAELYN
634.description: Long ago, the inhabitants of myriad stars─many more prosperous than Etheirys─sought to free their worlds from life's woes.

635.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006070_HYDAELYN
635.description: Sorrow and anger, conflict and hostility, despair...and even death itself. But as Meteion reported, every attempt ended in failure.

636.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006080_HYDAELYN
636.description: Darkness abideth within every living being, and can never be cast out.

637.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006090_HYDAELYN
637.description: Neither reason nor faith can challenge this immutable truth.

639.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006110_HYDAELYN
639.description: And in suffering find strength, and purpose. And hope.

640.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006120_HYDAELYN
640.description: As you have done so many times before.

641.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006130_HYDAELYN
641.description: Thou dost pursue an impossible dream, yet knowing this, you pursue it nevertheless. And thou hast learned to depend on others, as they do thee.

642.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006140_HYDAELYN
642.description: Thy yearning for the power to save the powerless hath ever driven thee to greater heights. Thou hast grown strong.

643.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006150_HYDAELYN
643.description: Though those closest to thee no longer walketh by thy side, their love remaineth thy guiding light.

644.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006160_HYDAELYN
644.description: For duty's sake, thou hast been bound by truths unutterable, time and time again. Yet thy heart hath never wavered, as thy companions will attest.

645.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006170_HYDAELYN
645.description: In thy pursuit of mysteries great, all thou believest is brought into question. Undaunted, thy thirst for knowledge remaineth unquenched.

646.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006180_HYDAELYN
646.description: The fires of hatred that once burned in thy heart burneth no more. From their ashes doth spring the light of love, warm and pure.

647.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006190_HYDAELYN
647.description: As witness to black calamity, thou despaired at man's helplessness. Resolved, thou didst unite a distant world on the brink of collapse.

648.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006200_HYDAELYN
648.description: And thou...my champion. When all did seem lost, thou never abandoned hope.

649.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006210_HYDAELYN
649.description: For every trial and every foe that did bar thy way, thou hast proven equal to the challenge, drawing courage from the many bonds forged on thy journey.

650.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006220_HYDAELYN
650.description: You have all known despair, and though the end approacheth, you walk on, heads held high.

651.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006230_HYDAELYN
651.description: Therein lieth your power. The strength to silence the song of oblivion.

652.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006240_ALPHINAUD
652.description: Then there is a means to confront her?

653.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006250_HYDAELYN
653.description: Yes, if you should prove yourselves worthy.

655.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006270_HYDAELYN
655.description: Nigh impossible is it to send mortals to the edge of the universe. Should you fail, there will be no second chance.

656.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006280_HYDAELYN
656.description: As the will of the star, I ask of you this...

657.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006290_HYDAELYN
657.description: Do you possess the fortitude to stand firm when all around you doth crumble? Do you possess the faith to vanquish despair itself?

658.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006300_HYDAELYN
658.description: Should you lack the strength to best a supreme deity, I cannot allow you to make the journey.

659.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006310_HYDAELYN
659.description: You must leave this star and never return.

661.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006330_ESTINIEN
661.description: Prove ourselves worthy, eh? Sounds straightforward enough.

662.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006340_THANCRED
662.description: Aye, no room for confusion there...

663.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006350_THANCRED
663.description: In any case, we've come too far to back down now.

664.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006360_URIANGER
664.description: I am of the same mind. What power I have, I shall bring to bear.

665.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006370_YSHTOLA
665.description: The three of you seem to be forgetting who we're up against... It's not every day we battle a divine being of untold power. Well, not quite every day.

666.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006380_YSHTOLA
666.description: Do try not to get underfoot. Needless to say, there'll be no margin for error.

667.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006390_GRAHATIA
667.description: Let us hold nothing back! For the people of this world and those beyond the rift!

670.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006420_HYDAELYN
670.description: Alas, the question I posed to thee in Elpis hath remained unanswered these long years.

671.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006430_HYDAELYN
671.description: I would hear thy response, Warrior of Light, shouldst thou emerge victorious!

672.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006440_HYDAELYN
672.description: I, the last of my kind, shall test thee. Come, prove thy worth!

673.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006450_HYDAELYN
673.description: At last...man has the strength to...

676.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006480_HYDAELYN
676.description: Though my power is in constant flux, I have always kept a reserve for this very moment.

677.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006490_HYDAELYN
677.description: It was a true test of your prowess. You have done well.

678.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006500_YSHTOLA
678.description: There is one thing I must ask.

679.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006510_YSHTOLA
679.description: By sundering the world into fourteen shards, the aether of all living beings too was divided. This reduction would in theory allow us to more easily interact with dynamis.

680.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006520_YSHTOLA
680.description: Having seen mankind brought to the very precipice of extinction, you wished for us to develop a means to overcome despair.

681.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006530_YSHTOLA
681.description: You believed we had the potential, and sundered all creation to see it fulfilled. To deliver us to that swirling maelstrom of dynamis in which our foe hides, and grant us the power to defeat her once and for all. Is this not true?

682.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006540_HYDAELYN
682.description: It is as thou sayest. 'Twas the trial to which I subjected mankind, and it hath led to untold bloodshed and suffering. There was no kindness nor justice in the tragedy I wrought.

683.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006550_HYDAELYN
683.description: When confronted with the almighty Zodiark, my only recourse was to rend Him and the world asunder, that His power be diminished for a time.

684.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006560_HYDAELYN
684.description: And so it came to pass. Now you, my chosen, have surpassed my expectations. Surpassed me.

685.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006570_HYDAELYN
685.description: I entrust the fate of the universe...unto you.

686.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006580_HYDAELYN
686.description: This crystal contains the memory of Meteion's passage through the stars.

687.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006590_HYDAELYN
687.description: Deliver it unto the Loporrits. They will guide you to her.

688.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006600_ALPHINAUD
688.description: Though they may be capable of crossing great distances, there is a vast difference between traveling to the moon and the furthermost reaches of the great expanse.

689.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006610_ALPHINAUD
689.description: And unlike Meteion, we cannot simply soar on waves of dynamis to our destination.

690.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006620_HYDAELYN
690.description: Indeed. To make such a journey would require an astronomical amount of aether.

691.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006630_HYDAELYN
691.description: But a solution lieth close at hand.

694.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006660_HYDAELYN
694.description: Ever since I became the will of the star, the aether drawn here hath slowly crystallized.

695.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006670_HYDAELYN
695.description: They who have answered my call know it well.

696.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006680_HYDAELYN
696.description: While I have remained hidden, it hath become the embodiment of the planet's will in my place. A faceless, omnipotent force of nature.

698.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006700_HYDAELYN
698.description: Alas, I can do no more. The fulfillment of this task doth fall to you, my chosen.

700.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006720_HYDAELYN
700.description: Darkness and Light. Despair and hope. As goeth one, so goeth the other. Become Light. Become hope.

701.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006730_HYDAELYN
701.description: I have a gift for thee... Come closer.

702.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006740_HYDAELYN
702.description: Long have I searched for a means to safeguard the future of this star.

703.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006750_HYDAELYN
703.description: Though I knew failure after failure, by recalling thy tales─and my promise to thee─I found the strength to carry on.

704.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006760_HYDAELYN
704.description: Though the world is ever changing, thy thirst for adventure hath never waned.

705.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006770_HYDAELYN
705.description: Thine unshakable resolve never ceaseth to amaze. To inspire.

706.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006780_HYDAELYN
706.description: As a mark of my gratitude, I bestow this final gift.

707.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006790_HYDAELYN
707.description: Thou dost possess the crystal of Azem, yes?

708.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006800_HYDAELYN
708.description: As Hydaelyn, I preside over the forces of stasis, tranquility, peace. The laws which impart stability to existence itself.

709.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006810_HYDAELYN
709.description: I will weave this selfsame power into the crystal, granting thee mastery over matter, to give form to the formless. Use it wisely, for it will not last indefinitely.

710.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006820_HYDAELYN
710.description: As thou hast seen on thy journey through the aetherial sea, souls are drawn to thee. Mayhap this trait will prove to be a boon rather than a hindrance...

711.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006830_HYDAELYN
711.description: It is thy hopes and prayers that enable Azem's invocations and give them life, so keep them close. But pray, remember this...

712.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006840_HYDAELYN
712.description: When the way forward is hidden even from the mind's eye, look not to the invocation, but within yourself.

713.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006850_HYDAELYN
713.description: These were the words of the crystal's original bearer.

715.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006870_HYDAELYN
715.description: Fulfill our promise. Right the wrongs committed when the world was yet whole. Silence the song of oblivion...

716.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006880_HYDAELYN
716.description: Teach her a brighter melody. Show her...our journey is far from over.

719.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_A8_000_002_NONE_VOICE
719.description: We will find our way, Venat.

720.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006890_HYDAELYN
720.description: It is I who should thank thee. For all thou hast done...and may yet accomplish.

721.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006900_HYDAELYN
721.description: Long after I have gone, though not even my soul remaineth...

722.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006910_HYDAELYN
722.description: My love will be with you forever, my dearest children.

724.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006930_HYDAELYN
724.description: Of this, I have no doubt. For yours is a light brilliant beyond measure.

725.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006940_HYDAELYN
725.description: Long after I have gone, though not even my soul remaineth...

726.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006950_HYDAELYN
726.description: My love will be with you forever, my dearest children.

728.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006970_HYTHLODAEUS
728.description: Some time indeed, yes... For you, at least.

729.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006980_HYTHLODAEUS
729.description: Believe me, I'd meant to get some proper sleep, but here we are, drifting along instead.

730.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_006990_HYTHLODAEUS
730.description: Well, well. You too? And so we remain to watch and wonder...

732.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_06005_007010_HYTHLODAEUS
732.description: To begin, we first must see the end.
